title: A protocol for isolation of primary human immune cells from the liver and mesenteric white adipose tissue biopsies
protocol: Add 10 mL of C-RPMI into a GentleMACS C tube.
Place the liver wedge (∼500 mg) into the GentleMACS C tube containing the C-RPMI.
Use GentleMACS Tissue Dissociator (program E.01) to homogenize the liver tissue.
Repeat dissociation program (E.01) 2–3 additional times if necessary.
Transfer homogenized liver tissue sample into a sterile 50 mL conical tube.
Wash GentleMACS C tube with an additional 10 mL of C-RPMI and transfer into the same 50 mL conical tube.
Spin the homogenate at 800 × g for 10 min at 4°C.
Decant supernatant gently.
Add 30 mL of 33% Percoll solution directly to tube containing the cells pellet.
Briefly shake tube by hand to mix cell pellet with Percoll solution.
Spin at 1000 × g for 20 min at room temperature.
Gently and carefully decant the supernatant following centrifugation.
Resuspend the isolated primary immune cell pellet in 5 mL ACK (RBC lysis buffer).
Incubate the suspension for 1 minute at room temperature.
Spin the mixture at 800 × g for 4 minutes at 4°C.
Gently decant the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 5 mL of C-RPMI.
Spin the mixture again at 800 × g for 4 minutes at 4°C.
Gently decant the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of C-RPMI.
Mix 10 μL of cell sample with Trypan blue at a 1:10 ratio.
Load 10 μL of this dilution into a hemocytometer to count cells.
Proceed to downstream application based on the cell count obtained.
Weigh entire mesenteric WAT biopsy.
Place approximately 3 grams of WAT into a 15 mL conical tube containing 10 mL of DMEM, high glucose, L-glutamine and HEPES.
Thoroughly mince tissue into small pieces using scissors.
Spin at 1000 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the media and red blood cells/pellet from each tube using a 5 mL pipette.
Add 7 mL of WAT digestion buffer to the remaining WAT layer in the tube.
Incubate on a shaking incubator at 37°C for 45 min at 225 rpm.
Vigorously shake tubes by hand after 45 minutes of digestion.
Filter the digested mesenteric WAT through 100 μm cell strainers into a 50 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the filtered material at 800 × g for 4 min at 4°C.
Decant supernatant and floating mature adipocytes to remove as much of them as possible.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 3 mL ACK lysis buffer.
Incubate the resuspended cells at room temperature for 1 min.
Centrifuge the cells again at 800 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Decant supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL C-RPMI.
Mix 10 μL of sample with Trypan blue at a 1:10 ratio (10 μL cell sample + 90 μL Trypan blue).
Load 10 μL of the diluted solution into a hemocytometer.
Count cells using a hemocytometer.
Proceed to downstream application.
Place 0.5 × 106 cells into a 96-well round bottom plate (non-tissue culture treated).
Spin the plate at 800 × g for 4 min at 4°C.
Gently aspirate media from the side of each well after spin completion, avoiding the pellet.
Add 200 μL of FACS buffer to each well.
Spin the plate again at 800 × g for 4 min at 4°C.
Gently aspirate media from the side of each well after spin, avoiding the pellet.
Add 25 μL of FACS buffer and 2 μL of human IgG (1 mg/mL) to each well.
Incubate plate for 10 min at 4°C.
Add antibody master mix prepared previously to each well.
Pipette up and down to mix thoroughly.
Incubate plate in the dark for 30 min at 4°C.
Following incubation, add 150 μL of cold FACS buffer to each well.
Spin the plate again at 800 × g for 4 min at 4°C.
Gently aspirate media from the side of each well after spin.
Add 100 μL of BD Cytofix Buffer to each well, resuspending cell pellet by pipetting up and down.
Incubate plate for 30 min at 4°C.
Spin the plate again at 800 × g for 4 min at 4°C.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 200 μL of cold FACS buffer per well.
Transfer cells to flow tubes for acquisition, storing them at 4°C until use.
Analyze FCS files using desired flow cytometry analysis software.
Gate on lymphocytes to exclude cellular debris based on forward and side scatter.
Exclude doublets by gating on singlets.
Apply live cell positive gate.
Gate positively for CD45+ cells.
Gate positively for CD3+ and CD4+ cells to identify CD4+ T cells.
Gate positively for CD3+ and CD8+ cells to identify CD8+ T cells.
From the second staining panel, gate on lymphocytes based on forward and side scatter to exclude cellular debris.
Exclude doublets by gating on singlets from the previous step.
Apply live cell positive gate again.
Gate positively for CD45+ cells.
Gate positively for CD11b and CD15 to identify macrophages/monocytes (CD11b+CD15low) and neutrophils (CD11bhighCD15high).
Gate positively for HLA-DR high and negatively for CD3, CD16, and CD19 to identify dendritic cells.
Gate on CD11c vs CD123 to distinguish plasmacytoid DC (CD11c-CD123+) from myeloid DC (CD11c+CD123-).
Gate on CD11c vs CD14 to exclude monocytes.
Plate 0.5×10^6 cells in 48-well plates in 500 μL of C-RPMI- one well for unstimulated and one well for PMA/Ionomycin (PMA/Iono) stimulation.
Prepare the following stimulation solution.
Add 25 μl of the solution prepared to the stimulated well.
Incubate at 37°C in 5% CO2 for 4 h.
Prepare flow antibody master mix for extracellular antigens 30 min prior to the end of PMA/Ionomycin incubation.
Transfer 0.5 × 106 cells from unstimulated and stimulated conditions into a 96-well round bottom plate.
Spin plate at 800 × g for 4 min at 4°C.
Gently aspirate media from each well, avoiding the pellet.
Add 200 μl of FACS buffer to each well.
Spin plate at 800 × g for 4 min at 4°C.
Gently aspirate media from each well, avoiding the pellet.
Add 25 μl of FACS buffer and 2 μL of human IgG to each well.
Incubate for 10 min at 4°C.
Pipette up and down to mix antibody master mix with cells in the plate.
Incubate plate for 30 min at 4°C, protecting from light.
Add 150 μL of cold FACs Buffer after incubation.
Spin at 800 × g for 4 min at 4°C.
Gently aspirate media.
Add 100 μL of BD Cytofix Buffer to each well and resuspend cell pellet by pipetting up and down.
Incubate plate for 30 min at 4°C.
Spin at 800 × g for 4 min at 4°C.
Gently aspirate supernatant from well without touching the cell pellet.
Prepare 1× BD Perm Wash by diluting 10× BD Perm Wash to 1× in distilled water.
Add antibody master mix prepared previously to each well and pipet up and down to mix.
Incubate plate for 1 h at 4°C.
Following incubation, add 200 μL of cold 1× BD Perm Wash.
Spin at 800 × g for 4 min at 4°C.
Gently aspirate supernatant from well without touching the cell pellet.
Add 220 μL of cold FACs Buffer to each well.
Spin at 800 × g for 4 min at 4°C.
Gently aspirate supernatant from well without touching the cell pellet.
Re-suspend the cell pellet in 200 μL of cold FACS buffer and transfer to flow tube for acquisition.
Store at 4°C.
Analyze FCS files using desired flow cytometry analysis software.
Routinely use FlowJo for flow cytometry data analysis.
